en.name: Shucked mussels
en.summary: These are mussels taken out of the shell and sold as meat, usually sitting in their own liquor in a tub. From purchase they keep 3–10 days refrigerated — go by the printed date within that — and 3–4 months frozen.
en.pantry: Shucked shellfish must never be left at room temperature. Out of the shell the meat has no protection at all, and bivalves filter their water, so they concentrate whatever was in it; Vibrio bacteria multiply fast in warmth. Carry the tub home cold, keep it below 4 °C (40 °F), and follow the 2-hour rule, or 1 hour above 32 °C (90 °F). A tub that has been warm is not rescued by the fridge.
en.fridge: Keep the tub at 4 °C (40 °F) or below on the bottom shelf, with the meat covered by its own liquor, and use it within 3–10 days from purchase — the printed date decides where in that range yours sits, and a tub you have opened belongs at the short end. Do not drain the liquor off: it keeps the meat from drying and stops the surface oxidising. Pour off and discard any liquid that has gone cloudy or ropy rather than topping it up with water.
en.freezer: Shucked mussels keep 3–4 months at −18 °C (0 °F). Freeze them in their own liquor in a rigid container with a little headspace, or bag them flat with just enough liquor to cover — the liquid is what keeps the air off, and exposed mussel meat freezer-burns quickly. Frozen food stays safe indefinitely at −18 °C; the months are about quality, and mussel meat shrinks and toughens at the far end. Cook them from frozen or nearly so, and add them at the end of a dish.
en.thawing: Thaw in the fridge overnight in their liquor, or drop them into a hot dish from frozen. Never thaw shellfish on the counter or in warm water, and do not refreeze.
spoilage: Liquor gone cloudy, ropy or slippery.
A sour, sulphurous or strongly fishy smell rather than a clean sea one.
Meat that has gone grey, mushy or slimy instead of plump and firm.
A bulging or gassy tub, or bubbles in the liquid.
tips: Keep the meat covered by its own liquor, in the fridge and in the freezer.
Buy the tub with the furthest date, and note the day you opened it.
Add them at the end of cooking; overcooked mussel meat turns to rubber.
Store the tub on the bottom shelf where drips cannot reach other food.

faq.q: How long do shucked mussels keep in the fridge?
faq.a: 3–10 days from purchase at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, with the printed date deciding where in that range. An opened tub belongs at the short end.
Yes, 3–4 months at −18 °C, frozen in their own liquor so the air cannot reach the meat.

faq.q: Should you drain the liquid off mussel meat?
faq.a: No. The liquor protects the meat from drying and oxidising. Discard the tub if the liquor has gone cloudy or ropy.

faq.q: Are shucked mussels safe to eat raw?
faq.a: Raw shellfish carries a Vibrio and norovirus risk and is not advised for pregnant people, young children or anyone immunocompromised. Cook shucked mussels through.

zh.name: 淡菜肉
zh.summary: 這裡指的是已經去殼、以肉的形式販售的淡菜，通常連同自身的汁液裝在盒裡。從購買日起冷藏可放 3～10 天（實際以標示日期為準），冷凍 3～4 個月。
zh.pantry: 去殼的貝肉絕對不能放室溫。離開殼之後它完全沒有保護，而雙殼貝會過濾海水、把水裡的東西濃縮起來；弧菌屬細菌在溫暖環境中繁殖很快。請保冷帶回家，維持在 4 °C 以下，並守 2 小時原則，室溫超過 32 °C 時為 1 小時。已經被放溫過的那一盒，冰回去也救不回來。
zh.fridge: 整盒放 4 °C 以下的最下層，貝肉要泡在自身汁液裡，並在購買後 3～10 天內用完——你手上這盒落在區間的哪裡，由標示日期決定，而已經開封的請取短端。不要把汁液倒掉：那是防止貝肉乾掉、也是阻止表面氧化的東西。汁液如果變混濁或牽絲，請整盒丟棄，不要加水補上去。
zh.freezer: 去殼淡菜在 −18 °C 下可放 3～4 個月。請連同汁液裝進硬質容器並留一點膨脹空間，或壓平裝袋、汁液剛好蓋過貝肉——液體的作用是隔絕空氣，暴露的貝肉很快就會凍燒。−18 °C 下安全性是無限期的，月數講的是品質；放到後段貝肉會縮水變硬。請直接從冷凍或半解凍下鍋，並在料理最後才加入。
zh.thawing: 連汁液放冷藏隔夜解凍，或直接從冷凍丟進熱鍋。貝類不要放室溫或泡溫水解凍，也不要再次冷凍。
spoilage: 汁液變混濁、牽絲或滑膩。
聞起來發酸、有硫味或強烈腥味，而不是乾淨的海味。
貝肉轉灰、軟爛黏滑，而不是飽滿結實。
盒子鼓脹有氣，或液體中冒泡。
tips: 不論冷藏或冷凍，都讓貝肉泡在自身汁液裡。
挑日期最遠的那盒，並記下開封日。
料理最後才下鍋；煮過頭的淡菜肉像橡皮。
整盒放最下層，滴出來的水碰不到其他食物。

faq.q: 去殼淡菜冷藏可以放多久？
faq.a: 4 °C 以下從購買日起 3～10 天，實際看標示日期；已開封的請取短端。
可以，−18 °C 下 3～4 個月，連汁液一起冷凍，讓空氣接觸不到貝肉。
不要。那些汁液防止貝肉乾掉和氧化。汁液變混濁或牽絲時，請整盒丟棄。
生貝類帶有腸炎弧菌與諾羅病毒風險，不建議孕婦、幼童與免疫力低下者食用。去殼淡菜請煮熟。
